$comment: Firehorse → Schema.org. Source of truth for scripts/schema.mjs and agent/schema.md. Components opt in with data-schema; nothing is published unless the visible content is real.

page.note: Once per site, usually on the home page. Hand-write it in <head>; the checker validates it.
Give it an @id (e.g. https://example.com/#org). Generated Service and Offer nodes link to it as provider/seller.

components.from: Each link becomes a ListItem (position, name, item) in visible order. The current page (aria-current) is the last ListItem.
components.parity: Same number of items, same names, same order as the visible trail.

components.from: Each <details>: <summary> text → Question.name, the rest of the panel → acceptedAnswer.text.
components.parity: Every visible question appears once, with the same wording. Only for questions the site itself answers.

components.from: Each fh-tier: fh-tier__name → name, the number in fh-tier__price → Offer.price, data-currency (default USD) → priceCurrency.
components.parity: Same tiers and the same prices as the page shows.

components.from: fh-card__title → name, fh-card__body → description, fh-card__meta → serviceType, the page Organization → provider.
components.parity: Name and description match the card.

components.from: <blockquote> → reviewBody, the name in fh-person → author, data-schema-item → itemReviewed.
components.parity: Quote text matches. Real, attributable reviews only; never invented or sample quotes.

components.from: data-schema-name (or the nearest heading) → name; each <li> heading → HowToStep.name, its paragraph → HowToStep.text.
components.parity: Same steps in the same order.

components.from: The in fh-person__text → name, the line under it → jobTitle, the avatar → image.
components.parity: Real people only; not agents, mascots or sample personas.

components.from: First <h1>/<h2> → headline, data-schema-author → author, the first <time datetime> → datePublished.
